Hi Megan 

Thanks for the clear list. Per Aishas note Im the security lead handling the evidence bucket. Below is a short summary and Ive attached the explicit evidence files referenced in your checklist.

SOC 2
- We are SOC 2 Type II certified; latest report issued 2026-11-20. We can provide a redacted report and a signed SOC 2 letter upon NDA. If you want the full report we can run the standard access process; let me know and Ill initiate it.

SSO / SAML
- Attached: redwood_sso_saml_metadata.xml  SP metadata (includes ACS, EntityID, certificate).
- We support signed assertions (SHA256) and allow NameID formats: persistent and emailAddress. Recommended attributes: email, firstName, lastName, groups (optional).

SCIM provisioning
- Attached: redwood_scim_schema.txt  SCIM 2.0 subset we implement. Supports create/update/delete. Endpoints: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups. Required attributes: userName (email), externalId (optional), active (boolean).

RBAC & admin controls
- Attached: rbac_admin_controls.csv  list of default roles (admin, billing_admin, dev_ops, viewer), role privileges, and typical separation-of-duty notes.
- All role changes are recorded in our audit log (audit entries tied to userID, actor, timestamp). Self-service role requests are routed through the admin console and require approval for privileged roles.

Next steps
- Please confirm whether you can accept redacted SOC 2 or need full report access (I can open a SharePoint link / request NDA).
- If you want a short walkthrough of SSO/SCIM config we can schedule a 30-min technical session with Dev.

Attachments included: redwood_sso_saml_metadata.xml, redwood_scim_schema.txt, rbac_admin_controls.csv

Thanks 

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
